en: Black‑and‑white studio portrait of a uniformed man from the early 20th century, wearing a peaked cap and tunic with shoulder straps and cross‑belt, holding a riding crop or baton. A large white signature is printed across the lower part of the image, with the caption "i. Zapfenstreich." beneath the figure. Along the very bottom margin, small print credits a Dresden art publisher.
